# Presentation reference

The component that plays cues on a unit, the cue data authored on abilities, buffs and unit definitions, and the API for playing a cue at a point. For how to use it, see [Presentation](../modules/presentation.md).

## VtUnitPresenter

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Presentation → VtUnitPresenter**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

Plays the presentation cues authored on abilities, buffs and the unit definition when the matching gameplay event fires: cast start and cast, the impact of an ability on its target, being hit, dying, reviving, and buffs applied and removed. One component on the unit prefab replaces the per-event wiring every game otherwise writes.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Animator (`animator`) | `Animator` | None | Animator that receives the cue triggers. Empty = first Animator in the children. |
| Audio Source (`audioSource`) | `AudioSource` | None | Plays cue sounds. Empty = first AudioSource in the children, else a one-shot at the unit's position. |
| Vfx Anchor (`vfxAnchor`) | `Transform` | None | Where effect prefabs spawn. Empty = this transform. |
| Dead Bool Parameter (`deadBoolParameter`) | `string` | `"Dead"` | Animator bool set true on death and false on revive. Empty = not set. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `event Action<VtPresentationCue, GameObject> OnCuePlayed` | Fires after a cue was played: the cue and the spawned effect, or null. |
| `void Initialize()` | Find the unit's components and start listening for its events. Runs on its own when the component wakes up; call it after adding the component from code. Safe to call more than once. |
| `GameObject Play(in VtPresentationCue cue)` | Play `cue` on this unit now. Returns the spawned effect, or null. |

## VtAutoDestroy

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Presentation → VtAutoDestroy**.

Destroys its GameObject after `seconds`. Added to effect prefabs spawned from a `VtPresentationCue` with a lifetime.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seconds (`seconds`) | `float` | 1 | ≥ 0 | Seconds until the object is destroyed. |

## VtPresentationCue

Serializable struct.

What to show and play at one gameplay moment: an animator trigger, a sound and an effect prefab, each optional. Authored on abilities, buffs and unit definitions; `VtUnitPresenter` plays them when the matching event fires. Gameplay never reads a cue.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Animator Trigger (`animatorTrigger`) | `string` | Empty |  | Animator trigger parameter to set. Empty = none. |
| Sound (`sound`) | `AudioClip` | None |  | Sound played once at the unit. Empty = none. |
| Vfx Prefab (`vfxPrefab`) | `GameObject` | None |  | Effect prefab spawned at the unit's effect anchor. Empty = none. |
| Vfx Seconds (`vfxSeconds`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Seconds until the spawned effect is destroyed. 0 = the prefab manages its own lifetime. |
| Scale To Area (`scaleToArea`) | `bool` | Off |  | Area cues only: scale the effect's width and depth by the area radius. Author the prefab for a radius of 1. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsEmpty { get; }` | True when the cue has nothing to play. |

## VtPresentation

Static class.

Plays a `VtPresentationCue` at a point in the world instead of on a unit: where an area ability lands, or each pulse of a lingering ground effect. The sound plays at the point and the effect prefab spawns there, scaled to the area when the cue has `VtPresentationCue.scaleToArea` on. Animator triggers are ignored because there is no unit.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static event Action<VtPresentationCue, Vector3, float> OnPlayedAt` | Fires after a cue played at a point: the cue, the point and the area radius, or 0. |
| `static GameObject PlayAt(in VtPresentationCue cue, Vector3 position, float areaRadius = 0f)` | Play `cue` at `position`. Returns the spawned effect, or null. |
